name: US FTC Endorsement Guides
description: US Federal Trade Commission Health Products & Influencer Endorsement Guides
note: Rule IDs are our own labels, not official clause numbers, and the descriptions are plain-language summaries.

rules.title: Clear and Conspicuous Material Connection
rules.description: Disclosures such as '#Ad' or 'Sponsored' must be unavoidable and placed above the fold or in the opening audio/video frame, not buried in hashtags or comments.
rules.source: FTC Guides Concerning the Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising (16 CFR Part 255)

rules.title: Competent and Reliable Scientific Evidence
rules.description: Health, dermatological, and efficacy claims must be backed by competent scientific evidence from human clinical trials before dissemination.
rules.source: FTC Health Products Compliance Guidance & Section 5 of the FTC Act

rules.title: Objective Superlative Substantiation
rules.description: Superlative assertions ('#1 rated', 'most effective serum') imply objective fact and must be substantiated by consumer survey or independent sales auditing.
